findings.title: Gate the now-unused physical-section control to test builds
findings.body: The new production collector calls joint_section_source, which no longer delegates physical-only work to Facet::section. Every remaining .section call is in cfg(test) modules/functions, including the retained joint_section control. Facet::section itself remains pub(crate) and compiled in the normal library at source.rs223 with no dead-code allowance. It is therefore dead code in the non-test target, so the required strict Clippy -D warnings gate will fail even though test builds use it. This is a source-established warning/gate blocker, not an executed compiler/lint result.
findings.requestedChange: Retain the exact independent method body but compile it under cfg(test), and gate the add/scale imports that are used only by that method in source.rs to avoid replacing the dead-code warning with unused imports. Do not remove the control, add lint suppressions or alter geometry/prices/guards/assertions. Update the bounded source-preservation proof for that metadata/import-only correction.
findings.evidence: Repository-wide .section call search: only source.rs test module, sections.rs cfg(test) joint_section and cfg(test) test modules. Production new kernel has no call. source.rs add/scale are used only inside section; sub remains used by production normal/contains code. No crate-level allow(dead_code)/allow(warnings) exists.

wholeSemanticReview: Production cell grouping and rank dispatch are withdrawn by restoring the original contiguous constructor and membership reservation and gating cell module/dispatch to tests. All cell implementation and test bodies remain unchanged. Original bounds, source ordinal storage, generic ray logic and prior independent publisher remain available to controls; no source geometry is changed by withdrawal.

Certified owner separation requires an original support whose exact projected affine distance is strictly positive at all three ORIGINAL source vertices. Affinity over their convex triangle gives a positive minimum finite gap on the entire source domain. Certified owner boundary triangles lie behind every original support, so a separated owner cannot supply a physical intersection/point/interval/coplanar field inside that source triangle; omitted raw segments would have clipped to None before protected/event admission. This is finite-domain geometry proof, not a sampled occupancy cache.

Parallel strictly positive constant proves a global source-plane gap; zero constant never marks separation. Existing own-source support lookup marks only outside outward occupancy and leaves separated=false. Equal/tangent/shared-edge/full-face/corner contacts and uncertified/unknown owner eligibility therefore remain. A previously established strict gap is preserved across later supports. Retained projected equations and arbitrary-sample occupied control stay unchanged; only occupied_facet may skip separated owners. Arrangement checks strict inside(domain,sample) before invoking visibility, so its callback satisfies this domain restriction.

Physical-only traversal preserves exact closed bbox predicates and adds charged separated-owner lookup. A uniform owner proves all descendants share that owner, allowing a known-unseparated flag to avoid repeated lookups; mixed leaves check original owner IDs. Joint traversal keeps physical/outward eligibility independent: only physical candidates gain separation filtering, while uncertified outward map membership, original whole-plane predicate, owner proof and multiplicity remain. Two/five fields per pending node fit the existing8perdepth stack bound. Original source order is retained; test-only cell mode still restores full ordered payloads.

New joint kernel preserves three exact distances and original all-zero coplanarity/three-edge output. Charged sign classification excludes edge walks only for all-strict-positive/all-strict-negative physical cases or all-positive/all-nonpositive outward-only cases. Physical zeros never qualify for this omission. Opposite nonzero sign bits equal the old negative distance-product predicate; outward positive/nonpositive comparison preserves the zero-below-epsilon convention. Every remaining edge keeps its visit and order.

Crossings ending on a zero-distance vertex reuse that exact original point; the same three checked coordinate visits still run. Nonzero crossings retain exact old interpolation and checks. Physical zero-point insertion, sorted min/max physical interval, duplicate limiting point multiplicity and incomplete-section refusal remain. No coordinate/UV bit guard, input audit, affine field, protected contact, star, witness, topology or positive-volume check is weakened.

Old physical-only kernel delegated into an extra48-slot guard under the96caller frame. New single shared kernel no longer has that nested frame; it admits96caller+8explicit sign/control scratch. This is a new actual workspace, not a waiver of the original retained control guard. Three distances plus classification cost4 in strict-empty case versus old completed edge walk; remaining actual edge/coordinate/hit/map/proof/lookup operations retain their prices. New finite proof evaluates each source vertex/support at1charged operation and stops only on actual failure of strictness or a prior proven gap. Separated bool fits existing16-owner reservation; equation geometry/storage is unchanged.

Rows build/collector wrappers restore their entry reservations on error after owned temporaries drop. Original rows/equations, independent32row construction/query scratch and map prices remain admitted; source kernel8scope releases on success/error after sign state drops while returned geometry remains under caller96. Node traversal stack and returned ordinal/record reservations remain. Publisher holds rows through arrangement callback and drops/releases before propagating arrangement failure. No global failed-prefix cleanup policy is changed.

Four authored cases compare all27signpatterns under4physical/outward flag combinations with exact old physical segments/coplanarity/limiting order; require reused oversized zero endpoint Rational refusal in both lanes; compare complete clipped arrangement/physical/protected/work outputs for parallel gap/nonparallel finite gap/equality; compare full primitive/subdivided opposite tetrahedron triangles/nonzero affine fields/all witnesses/retained ledger and analytic volume8/3; exercise exact/one-short row storage, collector rollback,104/103scratch and4/3operation boundaries. All lane labels and10x paired monotonic assertions remain unrun. Existing full-face/corner-negative and322/108/120 controls are retained.
